questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Convert the hexadecimal numeral $\mathrm{ABCD}$ into binary numeral
questions.solution:
Replacing each hexadecimal digit by the corresponding 4 -digit binary numeral, we have

(\mathrm{ABCD})_{16}=(1010101111001101)_{2}

questions.q: If $N$ is a set of natural numbers, then under binary operation $a \cdot b=a+b,(\mathrm{~N}, \cdot)$ is
questions.solution:
The structure $(\mathrm{N}, .)$ satisfies the closure property, associativity and commutativity but the identity element 0 does not belong to $\mathrm{N}$.
So, $N$ is a semi-group.
